_note: polish1. Hand-authored (our data, no game content): (1) which cue FAMILIES of the game's own footstep sound banks (decoded SDBK cue graph, docs/re-notes/audio-formats.md) serve each surface, role and gait; (2) the substring rules that turn the base-texture / model name under the foot into a surface. `python3 -m tools.importers audio footsteps` resolves (1) against the real banks into imported/audio/footstep_cues.json; tools/ue/import_ambient.py imports the waves and writes Content/Imported/Audio/footstep_cues.json, which UBullyFootstepComponent reads together with this file. Texture names are matched lower-case; the first rule whose scope fits and that contains any needle wins.
_contexts_note: Bank order per context (first bank with the family wins). FeetSCHL is the school-hallway bank (audio/CONFIG/areabank.txt: School_Hallways, Classroom, Staff_Room, Principal -> FEET\FeetSCHL.bnk); FeetAll is the outdoor bank (Test_Area, Island_3).
_cue_naming: {G}_<SURFACE>[_PL][_DRY]<n>: WALK / RUN / FST_RUN (students, fast run) or FRUN (player, fast run); _PL = the player's own variants (sneakers); P_{G}_ = player-only metal/dirt; HI_HEEL = girls' shoes.
